content.text:
I submitted **index 21** (Sb fraction 0.624), the highest EQE I measured at **0.077%**. The submission was accepted. I used all 5 EQE measurements and none of the 5 XRD measurements.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | 0.31 | 0.021 |
| 14 | 0.51 | 0.024 |
| **21** | **0.624** | **0.077** |
| 23 | 0.68 | 0.051 |
| 28 | 0.708 | about 0 |

EQE was low on the Pb-rich side of the line and rose toward the Sb-rich end. It peaked around Sb 0.62, just below the composition of the known PbSb₂O₆ phase (Sb 0.667). It then fell to zero by 0.708.

With only five points, the true peak could be at an unmeasured neighbour between 0.60 and 0.66 (indices 20 or 22). Those score nothing because they weren't measured. I also didn't run XRD, so I haven't confirmed which crystal phase is behind the peak.
